name: kinowo-js-quality
description: The tools behind scripts/js-quality-report (a report over every area, and the pre-push `jsquality` ratchet over the production ones): ESLint with eslint-plugin-sonarjs and typescript-eslint for complexity and length, jscpd for duplication, dependency-cruiser for module coupling. Kept apart from the root package.json so the pre-push ESLint install stays lean.
